one_liner.zh: 为 DSH 注册本地图片理解工具
one_liner.en: Adds a local image understanding tool to DSH

local: Configure a multimodal provider route and a model declaring image input in DSH Settings → Models.

completeness.reason: The tool validates the route, reads and saves an image, then returns streamed model text.

code.reason: The typed implementation separates path resolution and stream handling and handles input and provider errors.

docs.reason: Documentation explains setup, installation, route selection, and a usage example.

maintenance.reason: The repository has two commits and its recorded last push is in August 2026.

tests.reason: A behavior test file covers tool registration, successful image calls, and refusal/error cases; CI is not listed.

quality.notes: Maintenance and CI signals follow the extracted facts; implementation scores reflect the source files read.
